# LogRocket Blog

> A comprehensive resource hub for product teams, engineers, and designers to ship better digital experiences through technical guides, industry insights, and best practices.

LogRocket Blog covers the full spectrum of modern product development, from engineering architecture and AI tooling to product management strategy and UX design. The site features technical deep-dives, industry analysis, and practical guides aimed at senior engineers, product leaders, and design professionals.

## Key Topics

- TypeScript
- React
- Node.js
- AI Development Tools
- Product Management
- Engineering Leadership
- UX Design
- Vercel
- Schema-Driven Development
- Performance Optimization
- AI-First Engineering
- Product-Market Fit
- Engineering Culture
- Developer Tools
- Web Development Best Practices

## Engineering & Architecture

- [A complete guide to React performance optimization](https://blog.logrocket.com/a-complete-guide-to-react-performance-optimization): Complete React performance optimization guide with best practices

- [TypeScript at scale in 2026: What senior engineers should know](https://blog.logrocket.com/typescript-at-scale-2026): TypeScript best practices for large-scale development
- [Stop fighting forms: The schema-driven approach to validation](https://blog.logrocket.com/stop-fighting-schema-driven-form-validation): Schema-driven form validation guide for frontend and backend
- [Exploring Vercel's JSON Render: build dynamic UI from structured data](https://blog.logrocket.com/vercel-json-render-dynamic-ui): Guide to building dynamic UI with Vercel's JSON Render
- [Why engineering knowledge disappears as teams scale (and how to fight it)](https://blog.logrocket.com/dev/knowledge-sharing-engineering-teams): Guide to scaling knowledge sharing across engineering teams
